fields.summary_ko.0: NVIDIA CEO replacement uncertainty pressures supplier stock prices: TSMC (TSM) and ASML (ASML) declined 9.5% and 10.8% respectively, while NVIDIA achieved Q3 adjusted EPS of $2.68, exceeding the consensus of $2.47.
fields.summary_ko.1: NVIDIA's data center revenue increased 110% to $107.6B, with Q4 guidance of $130B (±3%) signaling supply chain relationship stability.
